identity_lookup.name: entity_lookup_by_id
identity_lookup.description: Reads the full entity record for a known entity ID to inspect aliases, groups, and attached policies

response_fields.data.name: Entity name
response_fields.data.aliases: All aliases attached to the entity across auth mounts
response_fields.data.policies: Policies attached directly to the entity

permission_check.name: read_jwt_role_config
permission_check.description: Reads JWT/OIDC role constraints and token settings to confirm intended validation and authorization bindings

permission_check.name: read_saml_role_config
permission_check.description: Reads SAML role constraints and token settings to confirm subject and attribute binding

access_test.name: read_secret_kv_v2
access_test.description: Attempts to read a KV v2 secret to verify whether granted permissions actually allow resource access

session_token_inspect.name: token_lookup_self
session_token_inspect.description: Returns current token identity, TTL, expiry, display name, policies, and remaining uses for freshness and identity checks

response_fields.data.entity_id: Vault entity bound to the session
response_fields.data.display_name: Auth-method-derived display name for the token
response_fields.data.policies: Policies granted directly on the token
response_fields.data.num_uses: Remaining use budget or configured use limit

admin_audit.name: entity_lookup_by_name
admin_audit.description: Reads an entity by name to cross-check whether different aliases or principals collapse into the same named entity

path_params.name: entity name observed from prior lookup or admin setup

response_fields.data.id: Canonical entity ID for the named entity
response_fields.data.aliases: Aliases attached to the named entity

admin_audit.name: entity_lookup_via_lookup_endpoint
admin_audit.description: Looks up an entity by alias name plus mount accessor or other criteria for collision forensics

response_fields.data.name: Resolved entity name
response_fields.data.aliases: Aliases that matched or are attached

admin_audit.name: group_lookup_by_id
admin_audit.description: Reads a group by ID to inspect policies and membership used in authorization decisions

path_params.group_id: group ID from create_identity_group or entity details

admin_audit.name: group_lookup_by_name
admin_audit.description: Reads a group by name to cross-check group alias resolution and policy attachment

path_params.name: group name from setup or alias mapping

admin_audit.name: group_alias_lookup_by_id
admin_audit.description: Reads a group alias to verify external group name to internal group binding

response_fields.data.name: External group name used as alias
response_fields.data.canonical_id: Internal group ID targeted by the alias
response_fields.data.mount_accessor: Auth mount accessor that owns the alias

admin_audit.name: entity_alias_lookup_by_id
admin_audit.description: Reads an entity alias to inspect alias name, mount, and canonical entity binding

path_params.id: entity alias ID from prior admin lookup

response_fields.data.name: Alias name from upstream principal
response_fields.data.canonical_id: Canonical entity ID bound to the alias
response_fields.data.mount_accessor: Auth mount accessor owning the alias

admin_audit.name: read_secret_metadata_kv_v2
admin_audit.description: Reads KV v2 metadata to inspect versioning, CAS requirements, and delete timers that affect test behavior

admin_audit.name: read_group_policy_application_mode
admin_audit.description: Reads global group policy application mode that changes whether identity group policies apply across namespace boundaries

response_fields.group_policy_application_mode: Whether group policies apply only within namespace hierarchy or anywhere
